name: スチームパンク
css: body { overflow: hidden !important; }
.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; }

.brass-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; border: 8px solid #b8860b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #8b7355, 0 0 30px rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.4), inset 0 5px 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3), inset 0 -5px 15px rgba(61, 40, 23, 0.5); pointer-events: none; }
.ring-outer { width: 520px; height: 520px; }
.ring-middle { width: 500px; height: 500px; border-width: 5px; }
.ring-inner { width: 485px; height: 485px; border-width: 3px; }

.roulette-base { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 480px; height: 480px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #4a3c2e 0%, #2c1810 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); pointer-events: none; }
#roulette-svg-target { background: #1a0f0a; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); border: 3px solid #8b7355; box-sizing: border-box; }
.center-mechanism { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 140px; height: 140px; z-index: 10; }

.mech-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, #8b7355 0deg 10deg, #6b5644 10deg 20deg, #8b7355 20deg 30deg, #6b5644 30deg 40deg, #8b7355 40deg 50deg, #6b5644 50deg 60deg, #8b7355 60deg 70deg, #6b5644 70deg 80deg, #8b7355 80deg 90deg, #6b5644 90deg 100deg, #8b7355 100deg 110deg, #6b5644 110deg 120deg, #8b7355 120deg 130deg, #6b5644 130deg 140deg, #8b7355 140deg 150deg, #6b5644 150deg 160deg, #8b7355 160deg 170deg, #6b5644 170deg 180deg, #8b7355 180deg 190deg, #6b5644 190deg 200deg, #8b7355 200deg 210deg, #6b5644 210deg 220deg, #8b7355 220deg 230deg, #6b5644 230deg 240deg, #8b7355 240deg 250deg, #6b5644 250deg 260deg, #8b7355 260deg 270deg, #6b5644 270deg 280deg, #8b7355 280deg 290deg, #6b5644 290deg 300deg, #8b7355 300deg 310deg, #6b5644 310deg 320deg, #8b7355 320deg 330deg, #6b5644 330deg 340deg, #8b7355 340deg 350deg, #6b5644 350deg 360deg); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

.mech-middle { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 70%; height: 70%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #b8860b 0%, #8b7355 100%); border: 4px solid #4a3c2e; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(184, 134, 11, 0.4), inset 0 5px 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3), inset 0 -5px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

.mech-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 50%; height: 50%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #d4af37, #8b7355); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 42px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 2px 5px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); }
.bolt { position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #4a3c2e; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
.bolt-1 { top: 20%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
.bolt-2 { top: 50%; right: 20%; transform: translate(50%, -50%); }
.bolt-3 { bottom: 20%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, 50%); }
.bolt-4 { top: 50%; left: 20%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 20px solid transparent; border-right: 20px solid transparent; border-top: 60px solid #d4af37; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)); z-index: 20; }

.pointer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 20px; height: 20px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #d4af37, #8b7355); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6), inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 240px; height: 80px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; color: #0a0502; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37 0%, #b8860b 50%, #8b7355 100%); border: 4px solid #4a3c2e; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #3d2817, 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 2px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), inset 0 -2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); transition: all 0.2s ease; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 4px; font-variant: small-caps; position: absolute; top: 570px; }
#spinBtn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; right: 4px; bottom: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); pointer-events: none; }
#spinBtn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #3d2817, 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }
#spinBtn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #3d2817, 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }
#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #d4af37; text-shadow: 0 0 20px #d4af37; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; position: absolute; top: 650px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(40, 30, 20, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #d4af37 !important; color: #d4af37 !important; }
